title: 50 storey residential tower, Brisbane CBD: flooring
workplace: 50 storey residential tower with foyer and 3 level basement carpark, Brisbane CBD
note: Facts are example inputs for testing. On a real project they come from the contractor's own procedures and the project's documents.

swms.title: Floor preparation and levelling
swms.task: Grind the concrete floors and apply levelling compound before the floor coverings are laid.

facts.silicaControls: Floors are ground with on-tool dust extraction. Fit tested P2 respirators are worn by anyone still at risk. The written silica assessment is done before work starts and attached to this SWMS.
facts.safetyDataSheet: Safety data sheets for the levelling compound and primer are kept at the work area: avoid skin contact, wear gloves and eye protection.

swms.title: Carpet and vinyl laying
swms.task: Lay carpet and vinyl in the apartments and corridors with adhesive, moving rolls by hoist.

facts.safetyDataSheet: Safety data sheets for the flooring adhesive are kept at the work area: use with ventilation, keep away from ignition sources, wear gloves.

steps: Lay carpet, vinyl and timber floors

swms.title: Engineered timber floors
swms.task: Install engineered timber floors in the apartments, cutting boards with drop saws.

steps: Lay carpet, vinyl and timber floors

rules.phrase: Use a power stretcher instead of a knee kicker
rules.source: Model Code: Hazardous manual tasks s 2.2, s 3.3, s 4.1, s 4.9
rules.quote: kneeling while trowelling concrete or laying carpet
